items.prompt: Why can final-depth output wait until all messages before sorting?

options.text: The messages are guaranteed to arrive already sorted by price.
options.why: Chronological events need not be price-sorted.

options.text: Only the final snapshot is requested.
options.why: The map can aggregate updates first and sort active levels once for presentation.

options.text: Sorting is unnecessary even for the final required order.
options.why: The final bid/ask output still has explicit price-order requirements.

options.text: The neighboring every-event spread task has the same observation contract.
options.why: It instead requires an observation after each event.

items.explanation: The map can aggregate updates first and sort active levels once for presentation.
